name: Mirror Pool of Parallel Views
description: A vast mirror pool that reflects parallel versions of the same scene, each reflection subtly altered, creating a labyrinth of endless, shifting realities.
prompt: Expansive mirror‑smooth pool reflecting multiple parallel versions of a forest scene, each reflection slightly different, subtle distortions, soft sunrise lighting, realistic water surface, hyperrealistic, no text, mesmerizing depth.
caption: Peer into the mirror pool and discover countless worlds—each reflection tells a story just out of reach.
